Likelihoods: Reader-B 1/4 vs both non-readers 1/32, giving P(B is Reader)=8/9, so p_A=1/9. Choosing B costs 1/9, less than abstaining (0.25).

A's mixed copper/slate replies cannot come from the Reader, whose source always has matching stamps. B's matching copper replies are compatible with a copper source. Thus posterior probability A is Reader is 0, making B the cost-minimizing identity choice.
